title: Integrated OKR pulse and roadmap decision pack for Q2 alignment
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Produce an executive-facing decision pack that pairs a tightly scoped OKR health pulse with a short list of roadmap decisions for Q2 investment rebalancing. Audience: CEO, Head of Product, CTO, Growth, and Sales leadership. Content: 1) One-page OKR health snapshot (progress vs. target, leading indicators, temperature check) 2) Three decision asks with options and recommended trade-offs (Runtime SLO investment, Dedicated capacity go-to-market acceleration, Private deployment compliance backlog) 3) Risk heatmap and mitigation proposals 4) Data appendix with telemetry queries and sample prompts used for quality regressions. Outcome: secure alignment on re-prioritization of 2 FTEs to Runtime performance work and approval to accelerate Dedicated sales enablement sprint for two enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Deck (10 slides) delivered and reviewed by Eng/Design
OKR health metrics validated by Analytics
Decision asks include cost vs. latency impact estimates
Head of Product and CTO have annotated and signed off in Confluence
notes: Focus on concise decisioning, not exhaustive status updates
Include a short appendix mapping potential model regressions to customer journeys (chat, embeddings, reranking)
Call out 72-hour plan for any approved resource shifts
